{{Quote|I'm afraid the deflector shield will be quite operational when your friends arrive.|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Episode 6">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
A [[CoMar Combat Systems/Legends|CoMar]] product, the '''SLD-26 planetary shield generator''' was capable of protecting a small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] or large [[Space station/Legends|space station]] with a nearly impenetrable energy [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield]] for an indefinite amount of time. It was the model used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to protect the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].

This shield projected an energy screen around the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] station while being based on the moon and was efficient enough to do so indefinitely. The components of the SLD-26 included an emitter antenna, projection focusers, shield projector, focus dish, control stations, [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], and a large power core. The one drawback of the SLD-26 was that its large size and considerable tower height made it nearly impossible to conceal its location.
